params.prompt: Cinematic wide shot of a quiet street of small local businesses at dusk: a bakery, a hair salon, a flower shop, a repair workshop, seen from across the street. Warm dark palette, deep coffee-brown shadows (#0B0907), soft warm window light, subtle yellow accent glow. Realistic smooth 3D render look, matte surfaces, no people, no readable signs, no text, no logos, no watermark. The upper half of the frame is a nearly empty dark sky with strong vignette, leaving a large clean dark area for typography. Square 1:1 composition, low overall contrast, moody and calm.
